## Context / Problem
Revise the completed verbosity research after user correction. The original ten deterministic signals were not merely unvalidated: the historical calibration refuted them as production recommendations. The final guidance must be artifact-specific, and any replacement deterministic rule or LLM criterion must show a positive effect on the historical ticket corpus before recommendation.

## Approach
- Scope writing guidance separately for executable ticket descriptions/plans, ticket comments/handoffs, ADRs, user-facing documentation, reference/API documentation, incident/security records, and session logs/research notes.
- Treat unchosen alternatives as inappropriate in an executable ticket once a path is chosen, but appropriate decision evidence in an ADR. Preserve artifact-specific exceptions for tutorials, troubleshooting, incident forensics, and reference material.
- Remove “owner” from the fresh-agent resumption check; test only current state, chosen path, constraints, proof, blocker, and exact next action.
- Explicitly classify all ten calibration-v1 rules as refuted for production use. Do not describe zero-positive results as useful signals, and do not recommend any signal with false positives greater than or equal to true positives.
- Mine the frozen 20-ticket sample for new, precisely defined candidate signals. Compute TP/FP/FN/TN for each candidate against the existing adjudicated labels. Recommend only candidates with TP > 0 and TP > FP, while clearly distinguishing retrospective discovery from held-out validation.
- Record the correction, artifact-scoped guidance, candidate definitions, measurements, limitations, and next validation requirements in the linked session_log.

## Artifacts
- Updated research in session_log 59a7-cb88-f2f9-4148.
- Updated calibration findings and final answer.
- No repository files.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Guidance states exactly which artifact types each recommendation applies to.
- [ ] ADR and user-facing-documentation cases are explicit, including why alternatives/detail may be appropriate there.
- [ ] “Owner” is absent from the fresh-agent resumption check.
- [ ] All ten prior deterministic rules are identified as refuted by the reported corpus results and withdrawn.
- [ ] Every newly proposed signal has an explicit detector definition and a historical confusion matrix with TP > 0 and TP > FP.
- [ ] Same-sample discovery is not represented as held-out validation or safe enforcement; the next validation gate is explicit.
- [ ] The linked session_log contains the corrected research and remains in the artifact list.
- [ ] No repository files are modified.

## Verification
Re-run candidate detectors over the frozen 20-ticket corpus, independently check the resulting contingency tables against adjudicated labels, inspect the updated session_log, and report only candidates meeting the empirical admission bar.
